content: Subnet calculator tools (subnet-calculator.com, cidr.tools/cidrtools.net, TunnelsUp, IPTP, SubnetOnline) universally provide: network/broadcast address, first/last usable host, host count, subnet mask + wildcard mask, CIDR/mask/wildcard conversion, binary representation, reverse DNS (in-addr.arpa/ip6.arpa) PTR zone. IPv6 tools additionally show expanded/compressed notation, prefix presets (/48 /56 /64), address count, and range. Client-side (no-server) calculation is called out as a privacy differentiator by cidrtools.net specifically. Advanced tools also offer VLSM/subnet splitting and supernetting/route summarization as differentiators, explicitly flagged v2 in this brief.
